performance.verdict: SOW is 40+ days overdue; ads are live but infrastructure gaps remain critical.

findings.text: 5 milestones overdue since Jul 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — no completed event recorded for any.
Meta CPL dropped 81% week-over-week to $72.99 on 8 leads — efficient so far, but 28-day volume (8 leads, $584 spend) is too thin to confirm the rate holds.
3-day signal (Sep 7–9): 4 leads, avg spend $64/day vs prior 3 days (Sep 4–6): 2 leads, avg spend $29/day — spend recovery is driving lead uptick, trend is positive.
GHL shows 134 contacts and 51 opportunities but 0 appointments and 0 won — 8 paid leads against 51 opps suggests intake pipeline is not converting; possible intake leak, not an ads problem.
Google Ads spend is $0 across all 28 days despite a ~$5,000/mo SOW budget allocation — Google channel is entirely dark with zero clicks and zero conversions.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; LSA verification is the hardest blocker with a 3–4 week lead time.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones due Jul 31–Aug 1 have no completed event recorded — Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting. Google Ads has spent $0 across 28 days, meaning ~$5,000/mo of contracted budget is idle. Nacer must confirm current status of each milestone by Sep 12. Success check: at minimum LSA verification submitted and Google Ads account linked by Sep 17.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 51 opportunities created, 0 appointments booked — confirm routing and speed-to-lead are functioning for the 8 paid leads received.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 51 opportunities and 134 contacts but zero appointments and zero won cases, despite 8 paid Meta leads at $72.99 CPL. This gap is an intake process issue, not an ads issue. Check that lead routing, auto-reply, and calendar booking (per SOW Month 1 deliverables) are wired correctly. Success check: at least 50% of new paid leads should have a booked appointment within 24 hours — confirm by Sep 14.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL through Sep 13 before scaling; 8 leads is too small a sample to confirm $72.99 CPL is stable.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL dropped 81% to $72.99 over the last 7 days on 8 total leads — encouraging but statistically thin. The 3-day trend (Sep 7–9) shows 4 leads at ~$64/day spend, which is positive. Hold current budget (~$47/day) and re-check on Sep 13; if CPL holds below $100 with 5+ additional leads, a modest scale (+15–20% daily budget) is defensible at that point.
